description:
Situated in City Centre with great access to local amenities and transport network is this purpose built self contained two bedroom third floor apartment which would be ideal as either a first time buyer opportunity or a buy to let option.

The property comprises; a large open plan living room/diner/kitchen, two bedrooms, one with en-suite, main bathroom, decked Balcony and parking. 

There are communal access and hallways, stairs and a lift.
Leasehold information: Ground Rent Payable: Yes
Annual Ground Rent: £250
Service Charge: 640.49 Per quarter 
Length of the Lease: 125 years
Start Date of the Lease: 01/01/2008
Council Tax Information: Band A

Agent Note
In order to purchase a property in the UK, all estate agents are legally required to conduct identity checks on everyone involved in the transaction, in line with anti-money laundering regulations. Farrell Heyworth outsource this process to a trusted third party, and a non-refundable charge will apply. Please contact your local branch for further details.
